definitions.explanation: A soldier or armed guard stationed to protect a place such as a palace, gate, or important building. Often refers to the ceremonial guards at royal or government sites.

examples.english: A guard is standing in front of the gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衛兵|えいへい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{微動|びどう}だに⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The palace guards did not move a muscle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衛兵|えいへい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}よう→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Tourists gathered in the square to watch the changing of the guard.

notes:
Composed of {衛|えい} (to guard, defend) + ⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧ (soldier). Refers to a soldier posted to guard a location, often a ceremonial palace or government guard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衛兵|えいへい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: for a guard to stand watch
- {衛兵|えいへい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: the changing of the guard
- {衛兵|えいへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to post sentries

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{番兵|ばんぺい}→番兵：29857_banpei⟧: sentry; guard on watch — emphasizes standing watch at a post
- ⟦{護衛|ごえい}→護衛：14225_goei⟧: escort; bodyguard — protects a specific person while moving, not a fixed post
